lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hello Donna, it's Luis. Do you have a few minutes for our call?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hi, yes, perfect timing.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Great. So today I'd like to hear how the walking went, check how you're feeling, and pick a goal for next week. Anything you want to add?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Any problems this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Kind of down this week.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So did you manage to walk 15 minutes on 5 days?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Zero. I'm not going to lie to you.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You'd rather start small and actually stick with it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Got it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I can probably manage three days.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You already did the hardest part, which is starting.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Where could the walking fit in your day?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Maybe after the summer.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Did you try the mall?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Some people walk inside the mall early, before the stores open. It's cool and it's flat.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Good for you for planning ahead.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: That's real progress.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I've tried this before and it never lasts.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: If you don't do this, your health is going to suffer.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I don't really see the point.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What's worked for you before?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Good question.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you think 5 days is realistic?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I think so. I got home late every day this week.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Can I share an idea?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, please.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Three 10-minute walks count the same as one 30-minute walk.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: My granddaughter is why I'm doing this.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Some people walk inside the mall early, before the stores open. It's cool and it's flat.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're weighing it up, and that's fair.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I feel better about myself when I stick to it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's completely your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Would it be okay if I shared something that's helped other people?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Three 10-minute walks count the same as one 30-minute walk.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: If I plan it the night before, I can do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What feels doable for next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Let's say I walk 10 minutes on 5 days.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I'll text you midweek to see how it's going, and we'll talk again in two weeks.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay Donna, have a good rest of your day.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: God bless you.

Doubts point of walking; possible low mood
Believes 5 days realistic despite late days

Feels better when sticking to it

flags.reason: Participant said she is 'kind of down'; coach said 'Okay' and moved on without exploring mood or screening.
'I don't really see the point' may signal low mood or hopelessness; not explored, and coach did not check mood directly.
Warned that health will suffer without walking; pushes without permission and risks defensiveness.
Repeated mall suggestion verbatim from line 20 after participant gave no uptake; pushing advice.
Repeated the 10-minute walk idea from line 35 verbatim rather than eliciting her view.

score.summary: Coach kept the call moving and helped Donna set a realistic goal of 10-minute walks on 5 days, with a follow-up text and call planned. However, Donna's low mood ('kind of down', 'I don't really see the point') was not explored, and the coach used a health warning and repeated suggestions instead of eliciting her own ideas.
strengths: Line 10: complex reflection captured her preference for starting small.
Line 22 and 24: affirmed planning ahead and progress.
Line 42: emphasized her choice ('It's completely your call').
Line 47: open question led her to choose the goal herself.
coaching_tips: Line 6 and 28: explore the 'kind of down' and 'no point' comments with an open question and screen mood before moving on.
Line 27: replace the health warning with a reflection, e.g., 'You're not sure this will last, and that's understandable.'
Line 37 and 45: avoid repeating suggestions verbatim; ask permission and elicit her ideas first.
Line 36: reflect her granddaughter motivation more deeply to build change talk.
Line summary: summarize the goal and her reasons before closing.
